paper_metadata.title: Microstructures and mechanical properties of CoCrFeNiHfx high-entropy alloys

evidence.quote: CoCrFeNiHf x (x=0.1-0.6) high-entropy alloys with different Hf additions are investigated in this paper.
The eutectic composition is important for EHEAs owing to its better liquidity and castability compared to off-eutectic compositions.
Crystalline structures, microstructure evolution, and room-temperature and high-temperature mechanical properties of CoCrFeNiHf x EHEAs were studied systematically.

evidence.quote: HEAs were prepared with specified high purity (>99.95wt%) Co, Cr, Fe, Ni, and Hf using vacuum arc melting in an argon atmosphere. Each ingot was re-melted for at least five times with electromagnetic stirring to ensure compositional homogeneity.
